fun plan() {
  val planTools = readRepoFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/agent/plan-tools.md")
  val taskContext = readRepoFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/task-context.json")
  val evidence = computeEvidence(planTools = planTools, taskContext = taskContext)
  val written = writeFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/evidence.json", content = evidence)
  val completion = runCommand(argv = listOf("safeoutputs", "noop", "--message", "Mm-compliance judge complete: evidence written with no findings to report."))
}
